label: SB 4 Buttons
description: A single-breasted waistcoat with four buttons, offering a balanced opening that sits between the deep three-button cut and the high-buttoning five. It provides a clean, slightly open chest while still covering the waistband, suiting both business and semi-formal looks. The four-button stance is common on shawl-lapel and lapelled vests.

garment.fabric: fine wool suiting with visible weave
